title: Anki Mature-Card Retention by Deck
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:review deck=* mature_retention_pct=*
| stats avg(mature_retention_pct) as avg_mature_retention_pct, count as events by deck
| sort - avg_mature_retention_pct
description: Shows average mature-card retention percentage by deck for mature Anki reviews.
value: Average mature-card retention percentage by deck helps compare mature Anki reviews across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `mature_retention_pct` on `language:review` events and normalize `deck` so Splunk can summarize performance by deck.
visualization: Bar chart of average mature-card retention percentage by deck.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights the average mature-card retention percentage for each deck so you can see what works best for mature Anki reviews.
